title: docs: update README — 2026-09-29
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Daily README update: Latest News and star history. Recent Apps is refreshed when an app is published.

gist.headline: The noticeboard gets a refresh
gist.blurb: The README’s Latest News and star-history charts got their daily refresh. Even the garden noticeboard needs tending.
gist.summary: The September 29 README update refreshed Latest News and the light and dark GitHub star-history charts to keep the repository landing page current.
gist.impact: README readers see current news and updated star-history visuals in both display themes.
gist.visual_concept: Polli updates a garden noticeboard representing the README, with a small news card and two star-history charts for light and dark themes. A CRT monitor robot helps hold the charts beside lime-green flowers.
